description: The Electric Choice tracker maps more than 3,350 data centre facilities across the United States and compares all 50 states. Contents: facility locations compiled from operator disclosures, public filings, permit records and open infrastructure databases, including hyperscale campuses, colocation hubs and AI factories; a headline of 176 TWh a year (4.4 percent of US electricity) and more than 990 further facilities under construction or planned in 47 states; state counts (Virginia 491, Texas 396, California 231, Georgia 231, Illinois 219); county-level clustering (Loudoun County 216) and a ranking of the 50 largest facilities by power capacity, led by 10 GW campuses in Ohio and Utah. Producer: the retail electricity comparison company Electric Choice, updated on 28 September 2026 according to the page. Coverage: the continental United States. Access: a public web page with a map and tables; no download was seen. Licence and cost: free to view; no reuse licence is stated. Caveats: a commercial compilation from secondary sources with no per-record provenance, so counts and capacities are unverified and planned projects may not be built. Simulation uses: it gives siting and capacity figures for data centre load growth, grid adequacy and exposure analyses. Related record: Icarus US data centers (data-icarus-us-data-centers), another US facility list.
